page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.g7a-nps1.16xlarge is a general-purpose virtual machine instance based on the KVM hypervisor. It features 64 dedicated vCPUs powered by an AMD EPYC 7T83 processor running at a base clock speed of 2.55 GHz. The instance utilizes the x86_64 CPU architecture and provides 256.0 GB of system memory, maintaining a balanced ratio of 4.0 GB of RAM per virtual core.

This instance does not include local storage, requiring external block storage volumes for persistent data. It features a baseline network bandwidth of 16 Gbps. There are no integrated graphics processing units on this instance, and it does not include complimentary public IPv4 addresses.

The hardware profile offers a balanced allocation of compute and memory resources, making it qualitatively cost-efficient for workloads that require high CPU core counts without specialized memory-heavy or GPU-accelerated requirements. Appropriate workloads include enterprise applications, web serving, containerized microservices, and general-purpose business-critical applications.
